dos.title: Tour the underground wine cellars (Cricova & Mileștii Mici)
dos.description: Mileștii Mici holds the Guinness World Record for the largest wine collection in the world; book cellar tours in advance.

dos.title: Travel with Turkish ID card directly
dos.description: Under bilateral agreements, Turkish citizens can enter Moldova using a modern Turkish biometric ID card without a passport.

dos.title: Keep the Transnistria migration slip
dos.description: If taking a day trip to Tiraspol in Transnistria, keep the paper migration slip received at the internal boundary post.

donts.title: Don't confuse Moldova with Romania
donts.description: While languages are shared, Moldovans maintain their own distinct modern statehood and cultural traditions.

donts.title: Don't take photos of military checkpoints near Dniester
donts.description: Peacekeeping observation posts along the internal Dniester boundary prohibit photography.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% in sit-down restaurants and cafes in Chișinău is customary for good service.
